fact: ONECI's director general said it will soon launch a zero-undeclared-birth campaign so that identity is created automatically on digital terminals on the day of birth.
ONECI's director-general says it is working to give newborns an NNI in maternities.
Ago Christian Kodia of Cote d'Ivoire said among the country's reforms the birth registration remains as the individual's ID number, with biometrics added to the ID for service delivery.
